svg.title: The Analysis Senior Responsible Officer's journey
svg.desc: 7 steps in rows, each giving where you are in the playbook, what you do and what you produce. 1. Business Critical analysis: Be named at scoping, before the analysis starts. Produces: The register entry, with your name against it. 2. The Analysis Senior Responsible Officer: Risks across the lifecycle, and suitability for the intended use. Produces: Nothing recorded yet. 3. Phase 1 Engagement and scoping: Confirm the Business Critical status, and the resources and plans for assurance. Produces: Confirmed resources, and the register entry checked. 4. Phase 2 Design: Confirm design governance has been followed before the analysis starts. Produces: Design governance confirmed, and recorded. 5. Phase 3 Analysis: Stay aware of progress, and be available to approve at delivery. Produces: Nothing recorded. Your availability in the schedule. 6. Phase 4 Delivery, communication and sign-off: Approve it as fit for its intended use, before it is used. Produces: Your approval, recorded with what you confirmed. 7. Phase 5 Review: Revalidate the designation annually, and before any reuse for a new purpose. Produces: The revalidated designation, and the register updated. After the last step: What review finds is what the next revalidation starts from.
